name: @teamnetwork-nz/teamlink-mcp-server

tools.name: teamlink_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated TEAMlink user context for the configured API key, including `roleClass` (CSCClass) and `homeAccountId` (CSAID — the identity key scoping staff vs customer visibility).

tools.name: crm_search_accounts
tools.description: Search customer accounts. `csaId` is canonical for CSAccount.CSAID; `accountId` is accepted as a compatibility alias. Default mode is standard: exact case-insensitive matches. Fuzzy mode performs partial text/phone matching and name DIFFERENCE() matching. `isActive` defaults true unless explicitly set.

mode.description: Search mode. standard=exact case-insensitive matching; fuzzy=partial matching plus DIFFERENCE() for names. Defaults to standard.

q.description: General search value matched against csaId, alphaId, name, address, phone, and website.

accountId.description: Compatibility alias for csaId. Prefer csaId.

exactWebsite.description: Compatibility alias for website. Prefer website.

tools.name: crm_list_accounts
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility wrapper for listing/filtering accounts. Prefer crm_search_accounts for new work. `isActive` filters on CSAActive — only active accounts are eligible for transactional activity (orders/tasks).

tools.name: crm_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by id (CSAID). Response `isActive` (CSAActive) gates transactional eligibility for orders/tasks. Lookup-backed fields include industry/source/salesStatus {code,label}, team {teamId,name}, and accountManager/preferredEngineer/backupEngineer/bizDevManager {userId,name}.

tools.name: crm_list_account_contacts
tools.description: List contacts linked to an account. Defaults to active-only (CSPCA_Active); pass includeInactive=true to also return deactivated contacts for historical/reporting purposes — inactive does not mean deleted.

tools.name: crm_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts. `cscId` is canonical for CSContact.CSCID; `contactId` is accepted as a compatibility alias. `csaId` is canonical for account linkage; `accountId` is accepted as a compatibility alias. Default mode is standard: exact case-insensitive matches. Fuzzy mode performs partial matching.

mode.description: Search mode. standard=exact case-insensitive matching; fuzzy=partial matching. Defaults to standard.

q.description: General search value matched against cscId/contactId, names, email, mobile, and business phone.

contactId.description: Compatibility alias for cscId. Prefer cscId.

csaId.description: Canonical linked account primary key (CSAccount.CSAID / CSPivotContactAccount.CSPCA_CSAID).

accountId.description: Compatibility alias for csaId. Prefer csaId.

mobile.description: Mobile phone search; punctuation/spaces are ignored.

businessPhone.description: Business/DDI phone search; punctuation/spaces are ignored.

isActive.description: Filter by CSPivotContactAccount.CSPCA_Active when pivot context is joined.

role.description: CSCClass web-app role: A=Administrator, C=Customer, E=Engineer, M=Business Manager, P=Partner, S=Sales, T=Account Manager.

tools.name: crm_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. Response includes `role` (CSCClass) and `typeFlags` (contact type, distinct from role), `homeAccountId` (the CSAID this contact belongs to), and `isActive` — sourced from the CSPivotContactAccount pivot (CSPCA_Active), NOT the legacy/unused CSCActive column. An inactive contact may still be returned for historical/reporting purposes.

tools.name: lookup_selectors
tools.description: Get options for a CSSelectors list (Industry, Source, SalesStatus, OrderType, IncomeCat, City, Country, ...).

tools.name: lookup_branches
tools.description: List branches.

tools.name: crm_activity_get
tools.description: Get one CRM sales activity by id (CRMActivity.CRMAID). Returns account, enteredBy, assignedTo, targetContact, type/subType selector labels, due/completed dates, and completed boolean.

tools.name: crm_activity_search
tools.description: Search/filter CRM sales activities (CRMActivity). Supports customer/account, assigned-to staff, targeted-at contact, entered-by staff, completed/open state, due-date range, and free text. `completed=true` means CRMADateCompleted is not null; `completed=false` means open.

q.description: Free text: exact activity ID match, or partial match on description/type/subtype labels.

accountId.description: Filter by customer/account/company (CSAID). Maps to CRMActivity.CRMA_CSAID.

enteredByUserId.description: Filter by staff/contact who entered the activity (CRMActivity.CRMA_CSCID).

completed.description: true = CRMADateCompleted is not null; false = CRMADateCompleted is null; omitted = all.

tools.name: crm_activity_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries + totals for a CRM sales activity. CRM activity time is TMActivity with TMAType=A and TMA_CRMAID=CRMActivity.CRMAID.

personId.description: Filter by staff person who performed the work (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID).

tools.name: crm_activity_search_time_entries
tools.description: Search CRM sales activity time entries across activities. Supports filtering by activityId, account/customer (CRMActivity.CRMA_CSAID), staff performer (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID), date range, and text in time-entry or activity descriptions.

accountId.description: Filter by customer/account/company (CSAID). Maps through CRMActivity.CRMA_CSAID.

personId.description: Filter by staff person who performed the work (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID).

q.description: Partial text match against TMActivity.TMADescription, TMActivity.TMAInternal, or CRMActivity.CRMADescription.

dateFrom.description: Activity time-entry date range start (TMActivity.TMADate), e.g. 2026-01-01.

tools.name: task_get
tools.description: Get a task by id. Returns account/bill-to and contact actor fields as objects with IDs and names, while retaining raw ID fields.

tools.name: task_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time/incidental entries + totals for a task. Can filter by staff person who performed the work (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID).

personId.description: Filter by staff person who performed the work (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID).

type.description: Entry kind based on TMActivity.TMACost: time = TMACost 0, incidentals = TMACost non-zero.

tools.name: task_search_time_entries
tools.description: Search task activity/time and incidentals across tasks. Supports filtering by account/customer (TMTask.TMT_CSAID), taskId, staff performer (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID), date range, entry kind, and text in public/internal descriptions. Date filters are `dateFrom`/`dateTo` only; do not use `fromDate`/`toDate`.

accountId.description: Filter by customer/account/company (CSAID). Maps through TMTask.TMT_CSAID for the task the entry belongs to.

personId.description: Filter by staff person who performed the work (TMActivity.TMA_CSCID).

type.description: Entry kind based on TMActivity.TMACost: time = TMACost 0, incidentals = TMACost non-zero.

q.description: Partial text match against TMActivity.TMADescription and TMActivity.TMAInternal.

dateFrom.description: Activity date range start (TMActivity.TMADate), e.g. 2026-01-01. Use this exact parameter name, not fromDate.

dateTo.description: Activity date range end (TMActivity.TMADate). Use this exact parameter name, not toDate.

tools.name: task_search
tools.description: Search/filter tasks. Supports filtering by customer/account, logged-for contact, assigned staff member, entered-by staff member, call type, priority/severity, open/closed status, a date-logged range, and/or free text. Defaults to open tasks only unless status is set. Every filter is optional and combinable. Results include account/loggedFor/assignedTo/enteredBy objects with names, plus raw IDs.

q.description: Free text: exact task ID match, or partial match on task name/description.

accountId.description: Filter by customer/account/company (CSAID). Maps to TMTask.TMT_CSAID — the account the task was logged for.

loggedForUserId.description: Filter by the customer contact who requested/is authorising the task (TMTask.TMTLoggedBy_CSCID).

assignedToUserId.description: Filter by the staff member currently assigned to the task (TMTask.TMTAssignedTo_CSCID).

enteredByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who created/logged the task (TMTask.TMTEnteredBY_CSCID).

callType.description: Task/call type code: S=Support, P=T&A Project, F=FP Project, H=phoneSERVICE, I=siteSERVICE, A=Account Fee.

tools.name: order_get
tools.description: Get an order header + totals. Returns account/bill-to and contact actor fields as objects with IDs and names, while retaining raw ID fields. `orderType` is returned as { code, label } from CSSelectors/OrderType.

tools.name: order_list_items
tools.description: List order line items.

tools.name: order_search
tools.description: Search/filter orders. Supports filtering by customer/account, branch, order type, a date-raised range, who entered or authorised the order, who received/approved/invoiced/returned/credited a line, received/invoiced/returned status, and/or free text (order id, invoice/credit/RA reference, or with advanced=true also notes and product codes/descriptions). Every filter is optional and combinable. Results include account/enteredBy/authorisedBy objects with names, plus raw IDs. Returned `orderType` is { code, label } resolved from CSSelectors/OrderType.

q.description: Free text search — order id (exact), invoice/credit/RA reference (partial); with advanced=true also order notes and line product code/OEM code/descriptions.

advanced.description: Widen `q` to also match order notes and line product code/OEM code/descriptions.

accountId.description: Filter by customer/account/company (CSAID). Maps to PMOrder.PMO_CSAID.

branchId.description: Filter by the branch that owns the order account (CSA_CSBID).

enteredByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who entered/created the order (PMOrder.PMO_CSCID).

authorisedByUserId.description: Filter by who authorised the order (PMOrder.PMO_AuthBy_CSCID).

vendorId.description: Filter by supplier/vendor account on at least one order line (PMDetails.PMD_CSAID).

receivedByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who received at least one line (PMDetails.PMDRecBy_CSCID).

approvedByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who approved at least one line (PMDetails.PMDApprBy_CSCID).

invoicedByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who recorded a supplier invoice on at least one line (PMDetails.PMDInvBy_CSCID).

returnAuthorisedByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who authorised a return on at least one line (PMDetails.PMDRABy_CSCID).

creditedByUserId.description: Filter by the staff member who recorded a supplier credit on at least one line (PMDetails.PMDCdtBy_CSCID).

orderType.description: Filter by order type selector code (PMOrder.PMOType / CSSelectors OrderType CSSCode). Results return orderType as { code, label }.

received.description: Whether at least one line has been received. Not mutually exclusive with `no` — an order can have both received and unreceived lines.

invoiced.description: Whether at least one line has been invoiced. Same "at least one line" semantics as `received`.

returned.description: Whether at least one line has a return reason set. Same "at least one line" semantics as `received`.

tools.name: product_search
tools.description: Search the read-only product catalog. `q` splits on whitespace and requires every word to match as a substring in code, OEM code, description, manufacturer, or category. Filter by supplier/vendor and stock availability.

vendorId.description: Compatibility alias for supplierId. Prefer supplierId.

inStock.description: true = PMPOnHand > 0; false = no stock on hand.
